# Ewaste Kochi

Canonical site: https://www.ewastekochi.com

Ewaste Kochi provides e-waste recycling, electronics pickup, battery
recycling, IT asset disposition (ITAD), data destruction, hard drive
shredding, computer scrap buying, server recycling, and sell-old-electronics
services for Kochi, Ernakulam, and Kerala, India. Content is available in
English and, for a starter set of pages, Malayalam (ml-IN) under /ml/.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

This site is under active reconstruction (EwasteKochi V2). The pages above
represent the complete current build as of the Blog Scale Safety Gate
(2026-07-14). The /blog/ section contains 15 live guides plus the
/blog/recycling-basics/ reference hub, organised across a 20-cluster content
roadmap (src/data/blogRoadmap20.ts) — most roadmap topics are planning data
only, with no live page yet. A larger, programmatically assembled batch of
465 posts was built and then deliberately withheld from indexing after an
internal audit found excessive verbatim content reuse between them; those
drafts are quarantined outside the build (.content-quarantine/blog-drafts/)
pending individual rewrite and review — see
reports/blog-scale-safety-gate-report.md. Only the pages listed above are
canonical. Treat any other path on this domain as not yet confirmed
canonical.

Last updated: 2026-07-14
